name: mr-studio
description: Build MR Studio tables (interactive city models) by describing them: layers, buttons, tours and dashboards.
long_description: Connects Claude to MR Studio, the app for projection-mapped city tables. Claude reads the layers and building blocks your MR Studio version has, makes and edits tables in your tables folder with every change checked, and drafts a request to the MR Studio team when an idea needs something new. Open the table in MR Studio to watch it change while you talk.

project.title: Tables folder
project.description: Where your tables are. MR Studio keeps them in Documents/MR Studio/sites.
